capabilities: Organize notes into categories, groups, and labels
Run clock, calendar, countdown, stopwatch, pomodoro, and workflow widgets
extras: Free and open source; optional donations. Enabling data compression makes the data file unreadable in a plain text editor, and forgotten note passwords cannot be recovered.
problem: Quick thoughts get scattered across separate files, with no single place to organize, filter, and act on them.

relations.evidence: Copy a range of cells in Excel (or any spreadsheet) and paste it while editing a note

summary: Draggable card board for creating, organizing, and managing quick Markdown notes with categories, labels, alarms, and encryption.
